section24_4.heading: ### 24.4 Funding ledgers and concurrency
section24_4.sentence: Customer variable cost MUST be prepaid or BYOK; the system MUST NOT create unsecured founder liability. Default per-organisation concurrency: two Quick, one Deep and one export, with separate API/search burst limits and webhook queues.
